_comment: Copy to tables/s1-endpoints.json (git-ignored) and edit. Maps device names to the S1 scorer URL each one serves. No address is hardcoded in code; add or move a device by editing this file. A session picks a device with CORTADOS_S1_ENDPOINT=<name>, or falls back to the 'default' below. CORTADOS_S1_URL still overrides everything. Serve S1 on a chosen device by setting CORTADOS_S1_BIND there to the same host.
